name: Echo Point
bio: The main lookout over the Three Sisters rock formation and the Jamison Valley, in Katoomba.

name: Scenic World
bio: A Katoomba cliff-and-valley attraction with the Scenic Railway, Skyway, Cableway and rainforest Walkway.

name: Wentworth Falls
bio: Waterfalls and clifftop lookouts at Wentworth Falls, the start of the Grand Cliff Top Walk to Leura and Katoomba.

name: Govett's Leap
bio: A cliff-top lookout at Blackheath with sweeping views of the Grose Valley wilderness.

name: Katoomba
bio: The largest Blue Mountains town and the gateway to Echo Point and Scenic World.

name: Leura Cascades
bio: Waterfalls on the Leura Cascades and Fern Bower circuit; part is closed for repairs, so check the NPWS alerts.

name: Katoomba Falls
bio: Falls on Katoomba's Cliff Drive, with lookouts and walking tracks on the rim.

name: Blackheath
bio: A mountain town between Medlow Bath and Mount Victoria, the base for walks into the Grose Valley.

name: Blue Mountains Botanic Garden
bio: The Mount Tomah garden run by the Botanic Gardens of Sydney, with a visitor centre and the Bell Bird cafe.

name: Norman Lindsay Gallery and Museum
bio: A National Trust gallery and gardens at Faulconbridge devoted to the artist Norman Lindsay.

name: Grand Canyon Track
bio: A 6.3 km loop near Blackheath down through rainforest along Greaves Creek and out at Evans Lookout.

name: Evans Lookout
bio: A Grose Valley lookout above Blackheath, where the Grand Canyon walk climbs out.

name: Blue Gum Forest
bio: A stand of blue gums on the Grose River floor, reached by a strenuous descent from Perrys Lookdown.

name: Giant Stairway
bio: The Giant Stairway, a walking track descending into the Jamison Valley at the Three Sisters.

name: Ruined Castle
bio: An eroded rock formation on the Jamison Valley floor, reached by a long walk down from Katoomba.

name: Leura
bio: A small village known for the shops and cafes of Leura Mall, between Katoomba and Wentworth Falls.

name: Mount Victoria
bio: The westernmost Blue Mountains village, with a heritage hotel and bush walks.

name: Mount Solitary
bio: A multi-day, grade-5 walk to the isolated Mount Solitary, across the Jamison Valley from Katoomba.

name: Breadknife and Grand High Tops Walk
bio: A 14.5 km Grade 4 loop from Pincham car park past Belougery Spire and Crater Bluff to the Grand High Tops.

name: Siding Spring Observatory
bio: A working research observatory on Mt Woorut, opened in 1965, with a hands-on Exploratory and a free visitor gallery.

name: Coonabarabran
bio: The closest town to the Warrumbungles, about 35 km from the park visitor centre and 27 km from Siding Spring.

name: Hill End
bio: A former gold-mining town preserved as a NSW National Parks historic site, with its restored buildings.
